name: Group
description:
The Group component lays out its children in a normal, attached, grown or stacked
group, horizontally or vertically.

Use the `layout` and `orientation` props to choose how the children are grouped.

**NOTE**: This API is _slotless_ and is a single rendered layer: `<Group>` renders `Group.Root`.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Group component.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
